tools.name: expensein_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses with optional filters by user, type, status, and Unix-second date ranges (expense, submitted, approved). Returns the full filtered set. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/expenses.

tools.name: expensein_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense by id. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/expenses/{id}.

tools.name: expensein_list_expenses_for_approval
tools.description: List expenses awaiting, approved or rejected by approval. 'from' and 'to' (Unix seconds) filter approved or rejected expenses only. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/approval/expenses/{awaiting|approved|rejected}.

tools.name: expensein_list_invoices
tools.description: List supplier invoices and credit notes, with filters by status, supplier, approver and date. Returns the full filtered set. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/invoices.

tools.name: expensein_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: expensein_add_invoice_note
tools.description: Add a free-text note to an invoice. This adds a new note each time, so do not repeat the call. ExpenseIn API: POST /1.0/invoices/{id}/note.

tools.name: expensein_list_receipts
tools.description: List receipts with optional filters by user, expense, date range and whether they are attached to an expense. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/receipts.

tools.name: expensein_get_receipt
tools.description: Get one receipt by id. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/receipts/{id}.

tools.name: expensein_list_users
tools.description: List standard users, with filters by reference, e-mail, or a search term. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/users.

tools.name: expensein_get_user
tools.description: Get one standard user by id. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/users/{id}.

tools.name: expensein_list_categories
tools.description: List expense categories and what each applies to (purchase, mileage, time, invoicing), with visibility and default tax rate. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/categories. Also the cheapest call to test an API key.

tools.name: expensein_list_projects
tools.description: List projects. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/projects.

tools.name: expensein_list_departments
tools.description: List departments. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/departments.

tools.name: expensein_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/suppliers.

tools.name: expensein_list_merchants
tools.description: List merchants. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/merchants.

tools.name: expensein_list_tax_rates
tools.description: List tax rates. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/taxrates.

tools.name: expensein_list_policies
tools.description: List the expense policies on the account. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/policies.

tools.name: expensein_list_card_transactions
tools.description: List expense-card transactions, filtered by Unix-second date range, cardholder id or a search term. Returns the full filtered set. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/cardtransactions.

tools.name: expensein_list_purchase_requests
tools.description: List purchase requests, filtered by owner user id and status. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/purchaserequests.

tools.name: expensein_get_server_change_counter
tools.description: Get the current server change counter. Save it after a sync, then pass it as last_server_change_counter next time to read only changes. ExpenseIn API: GET /1.0/serverchangecounter.

tools.name: expensein_create_expense
tools.description: Create a new expense for a user. Each call creates another expense, so do not repeat it. ExpenseIn API: POST /1.0/expenses.
